messages.text:
"Game Overview: Open-World Action RPG with Infinite Progression
1. Core Concept @COMMENT_BODY@ Setting
Genre: Open-World Action RPG
World: An open map where players can freely move, explore, and combat monsters.
Objective: Defeat monsters, gain experience (XP), level up infinitely, collect randomized loot, and eventually unlock online PvP battles after reaching the maximum level milestone.
2. Character Classes
At the start of the game, the player chooses one class from four options:
Swordsman: Melee combat specialist with high defense and close-range physical damage.
Wizard: Ranged magical caster dealing high area-of-effect (AoE) elemental damage.
Ninja: High-mobility, stealth, and critical-hit assassin.
Archer: Long-range physical attacker with high attack speed and precision.
3. Leveling @COMMENT_BODY@ Progression System
Starting Level: Both the player and all monsters start at Level 1.
Scaling Difficulty: As the player's level increases, the monsters' levels scale dynamically to match or challenge the player.
XP Gain: Players earn experience points by defeating monsters, with XP rewards scaled based on the monster's level.
Level Cap @COMMENT_BODY@ Infinite Symbol:
The level system is technically infinite.
Once a player crosses Level 99,999,999, the numerical level text on the UI panel is replaced with the Infinity symbol (\infty).
4. Stat Allocation @COMMENT_BODY@ Skill Points
Level-Up Rewards: Every time the player gains a level, a pop-up window appears.
Stat Points: Players can allocate points to increase their character stats (e.g., Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Vitality).
Skill Points: The player receives 5 skill points per level-up to unlock or upgrade active and passive skills.
5. Loot @COMMENT_BODY@ Equipment System
Drop Mechanics: Defeating monsters grants random loot drops tailored to the player's current class and level.
Rarity Tiers: Items are classified into 7 distinct rarity grades:
Common
Uncommon
Rare
Mythic
Legendary
Ancient
[Insert custom highest tier if needed]
Buff Effects: Higher-tier items come with special passive or active buff effects to enhance combat performance.
6. End-Game: Online Multiplayer PvP
Unlock Condition: Players must complete the infinite level milestone (reaching the Infinity symbol (\infty) on their level panel).
Multiplayer Feature: Unlocks the ability to enter an online matchmaking queue and battle other players in real-time PvP combat.
"
